description: This file defines various classes and traits representing reasons why a Spark task ended, including success, failure, and specific failure types, with serialization support and detailed error messaging.

classes.name: TaskEndReason
classes.description: Sealed trait representing various reasons why a Spark task ended.

classes.name: TaskFailedReason
classes.description: Trait for reasons why a task failed, extending TaskEndReason.

classes.name: Resubmitted
classes.description: Object indicating a task was resubmitted due to lost executor.

classes.name: FetchFailed
classes.description: Class representing failure to fetch shuffle data, with details about the block manager and message.

classes.name: ExceptionFailure
classes.description: Class capturing runtime exception failures, including stack traces and optional exception serialization.

classes.name: ThrowableSerializationWrapper
classes.description: Class for serializing/deserializing Throwable objects, handling deserialization failures.

classes.name: TaskResultLost
classes.description: Object indicating task result was lost before being fetched.

classes.name: TaskKilled
classes.description: Class indicating a task was killed intentionally, with reason and failure handling.

classes.name: TaskCommitDenied
classes.description: Class indicating task commit was denied by the driver.

classes.name: ExecutorLostFailure
classes.description: Class indicating executor loss, with details on executor ID and reason.

classes.name: UnknownReason
classes.description: Object indicating an unknown reason for task end.

methods.name: exceptionString
methods.description: Helper method to format exception details into a string.

methods.name: withAccums
methods.description: Method to attach accumulators to an ExceptionFailure.

methods.name: withMetricPeaks
methods.description: Method to attach metric peaks to an ExceptionFailure.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Method to retrieve the exception object from an ExceptionFailure.
